name: buysmart-ecommerce
description: Full-stack AI-powered E-Commerce Shopping Platform with FastAPI, React, and Vite

scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json') ? 'frontend' : '.'; execSync('npm install && npm run build', { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' });"
